hypothesis: An absolute offset around the frozen rule avoids accumulated incremental-action drift; it may reduce cold violations without sacrificing energy gates.
diagnostic_scope: 27 existing development trajectories only; paired rule commands are from different trajectories and are associative, not counterfactual effects
diagnostic_gate: at least two SAC winter seeds have positive cold_Kh with zero engineering fallback; do not infer causality from aligned command gaps
action_mapping: rule_actual_command_C + 0.5 * residual_action; then original 18..23.25C and 0.5K/step mechanical projection
checkpoint_selection: original final cycle12 only; no intermediate development or earlier fallback
comparison_gates: unchanged_configs/v2_0.json; all registered seeds and conditions, terminal warnings unchanged
failure_policy: any failed seed stops pending launches and cooperatively stops active seeds; no retries, refunds, resume or replacements
stop: one fixed configuration only; freeze negative result if full development gates still fail; no second search or extra scene
